g.text: Top 12 complete genus lineages cover 10.19% of all reads; tile colour is prefix-node abundance
A genus is a complete path, not an isolated display name
Each row traces one Phylum-to-Genus path. Prefix-node percentages repeat context and must not be added across columns.
